This is our specialty map, we have owned this map for years in the quake scene and have proven many times how good we are at Castle of Vana. TUR! win for us.
=== DM3 === [[Image:SD3_NEU_Semi_SR-tVS_dm3.gif]]
backoffice map: 100% random map choice was luckily our home map :) "dont take this too seriosly" - by [[Slackers]]
== Report == There was a lot of drama involved in this game, first of all there was a huge problem because there was 2ms pingdifference between both teams it took a while before that was solved but ok. The first two maps were played. The usual procedure was that in case a decidermap was needed someone used the bot in #smackdown to name a random map. However it stated in the rules that it is also allowed (or maybe it was the official procedure) that an admin can let the smackdown backoffice program pick a random map. This is exactly what the [[SD NEU Season 3]] headadmin [[Apollyon]] did, the map became [[dm3]]. On itself this wouldn't have been a problem if not [[Apollyon]] had been cheering [[The Viper Squad]] on during the game and even though [[dm3]] was stated as [[Slackers]]' homemap they wanted [[dm6]] as a decider. What followed was an hour of whine with [[Slackers]] saying that [[Apollyon]] was not impartial and picked the decider himself, nobody could see what the backoffice said ofcourse since only admins had access to it. In the end the teams did play and as you can see [[Slackers]] won but the backoffice hasn't been used since to produce random maps. Some admins did some testing and it seemed to turn out that it created a random map which you could not change.

[http://www.challenge-tv.com/index.php?mode=demodetail&demo=26395 The demo] from the hour of whine was posted on [[Challenge-TV]] by [[flintheart]] three years later, if you have nothing to do it's worth to check it out. == Links == * [[SD NEU Season 3]] * [[Challenge Smackdown]] * [http://www.challenge-tv.com/index.php?mode=demos&event=226 Challenge-TV SD3 demos] == League Seasons == {{SD EU Seasons}} [[Category:Matchreports]]
